title: Standardize KV cache hit/miss metrics contract (names + units) for cost model inputs
author: Omar El-Sayed
description:
Context: The Standard Cost Model work (ENG-4823/ENG-4828) needs a stable, versioned contract for KV cache effectiveness so that (a) request-attributable cost can correctly discount cache hits, and (b) Console vs Optimize vs Finance reconcile on the same primitives. Today we emit a mix of metric names and inconsistent units (tokens vs sequences, fractional ratios with mixed denominators), and some clients interpret them differently.

This PR standardizes the KV cache hit/miss metrics naming + units, adds explicit semantics docs, and introduces compatibility tests to prevent accidental regressions.

What changes:
- Introduce canonical metrics under the `runtime.kv_cache.*` namespace with stable units and explicit denominators.
- Keep legacy aliases for one deprecation window (2 release trains) and add a linter/test that requires both canonical + legacy to be emitted during the transition.
- Update the telemetry contract docs consumed by Cost Model API and drift monitoring.

Canonical metrics (new):
- `runtime.kv_cache.prefill.tokens_total` (unit: tokens) — total prefill tokens processed for requests that were eligible for prefix/KV reuse.
- `runtime.kv_cache.prefill.tokens_hit` (unit: tokens) — prefill tokens satisfied via KV reuse (did not execute attention for those tokens).
- `runtime.kv_cache.prefill.tokens_miss` (unit: tokens) — prefill tokens that required compute (executed attention).
- `runtime.kv_cache.prefill.hit_rate` (unit: ratio 0..1) — defined as `tokens_hit / max(tokens_total, 1)`.
- `runtime.kv_cache.decode.tokens_total` (unit: tokens) — decode tokens generated (eligible for KV reuse is N/A; included for completeness/joins in the cost model).
- `runtime.kv_cache.entries_evicted_total` (unit: entries) — number of KV entries evicted from the cache.
- `runtime.kv_cache.bytes_in_use` (unit: bytes) — instantaneous gauge sampled at end of request.

Legacy aliases (still emitted, marked deprecated):
- `kv_cache_hit_tokens` -> `runtime.kv_cache.prefill.tokens_hit`
- `kv_cache_miss_tokens` -> `runtime.kv_cache.prefill.tokens_miss`
- `kv_cache_hit_rate` -> `runtime.kv_cache.prefill.hit_rate`

Semantics notes:
- “Hit” is defined strictly as reuse of prefill KV such that we skip compute for those tokens (not just a logical prefix match).
- `tokens_total` for prefill is the denominator for hit-rate. We do not use request-count denominators because batching + sequence-length distributions make those misleading for cost attribution.
- `bytes_in_use` is a best-effort gauge and is not used for per-request billing; it is used for capacity modeling and drift debugging.

Testing:
- Add `TestKvCacheMetricsContract_EmitsCanonicalAndLegacyDuringMigration` to ensure runtime emits both sets while the deprecation window is open.
- Add `TestKvCacheHitRateDenominator` to ensure hit-rate uses `tokens_total` and is clamped to [0,1].
- Update a small set of golden telemetry fixtures used by the cost-model validation harness to the canonical names (while still accepting legacy).

Why this is safe:
- Canonical metrics are additive.
- Legacy aliases remain emitted to avoid breaking downstream dashboards and older ingestion pipelines.
- Cost Model API will read canonical first and fall back to legacy until the deprecation window ends (tracked separately).

Follow-ups (not in this PR):
- Remove legacy alias emission after 2 release trains and once schema-version distribution shows <1% legacy-only clients.
- Backfill dashboards to canonical names in the observability pack.

Docs:
- Updated `cost-model-inputs-from-runtime-metrics` section to reference canonical metric names + units and provide explicit formulas.

Release note (internal): Telemetry contract now includes canonical KV cache hit/miss metrics under `runtime.kv_cache.*`; legacy metric aliases remain temporarily for compatibility.
commits: telemetry/runtime: define runtime.kv_cache.* canonical metrics + units
telemetry/runtime: emit legacy aliases with deprecation annotation
cost-model: update fixture reader to prefer canonical KV cache metrics
tests: add KV cache metrics contract + denominator tests
docs: clarify KV cache hit semantics (compute-skipped tokens) and migration plan
testing: local: replayed 30m staging telemetry sample; confirmed canonical + legacy emitted and hit_rate bounds respected
review_conversation:
Logan Wright: Can we be explicit about the denominator for hit_rate? We’ve had confusion between request-count vs token-count in Optimize prototypes. Also please confirm whether hit includes “prefix match but still computed” cases.
Omar El-Sayed (author): Added explicit definition + formula: hit_rate = tokens_hit / max(tokens_total, 1). Also clarified that hit means compute-skipped tokens only (KV reuse), not just logical prefix matches. See docs update + TestKvCacheHitRateDenominator.

Nadia Rahman: For cost attribution, do we need decode hit/miss too? Some folks are conflating decode KV (always used) with cache reuse.
Omar El-Sayed (author): Agree on confusion risk. Added `runtime.kv_cache.decode.tokens_total` explicitly labeled as “decode tokens generated; not a reuse metric.” Kept reuse metrics scoped to prefill only.

Thomas Baird: Please add a hard guard against emitting ratios >1 due to counter resets or partial aggregation. Also we should ensure the migration test asserts BOTH canonical + legacy for now.
Omar El-Sayed (author): Added clamp to [0,1] for hit_rate and extended the contract test to assert canonical + legacy both present during migration window.

Allison Grant: Naming: recommend `tokens_total`/`tokens_hit`/`tokens_miss` consistently, and use bytes for gauge. Please ensure units are documented in the contract file.
Omar El-Sayed (author): Adopted consistent naming and added `unit:` fields in the contract schema. `bytes_in_use` is now explicitly a gauge sampled at request end.

Sofia Ivanova: Looks good. One more: note that `entries_evicted_total` is affected by per-GPU cache partitioning; call out it’s a debug/capacity metric not for billing.
Omar El-Sayed (author): Added that note in docs and contract description.

Logan Wright: Approved.
Nadia Rahman: Approved.
Sofia Ivanova: Approved.
release_notes: Telemetry: Standardized KV cache hit/miss metric contract for cost model inputs (`runtime.kv_cache.*`). Legacy aliases remain emitted temporarily for compatibility; downstream should migrate to canonical names.
